what: Envato's 2025 Cyber Sale offered up to 50% off standard licenses on select ThemeForest and CodeCanyon items, starting November 19, 2025 at 2:00AM UTC, ending December 2, 2025 at 12:59PM UTC; VideoHive, GraphicRiver, 3DOcean, and AudioJungle were not included.
verbatim_snippet: "Up to 50% off standard licences on select Themeforest and CodeCanyon items. VideoHive, GraphicRiver, 3DOcean and AudioJungle are not included in the sale. Promotional period starts Wednesday, November 19, 2025, at 2:00AM UTC."
notes: Page returns 403 on direct access. Snippet from search engine index tied to this specific URL. Extended snippet also confirms end date: "standard promotional period ends on Tuesday 2nd December 2025, 12:59pm UTC." Discounts applied only to standard licenses; extended and other license types not included.
